<thought>To find the template that reproduces the Still‑Gennari HWE reaction for the given product, I will search the template catalog using the product SMILES and criteria that match the forward reaction: formation of an alkene and a carboxylic ester, and breaking of a phosphonate group. The product SMILES is the first precursor from the previous step.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["phosphonate"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["alkene", "carboxylic_ester"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
